text:
Sam: FYI, spotted a spike in TLS handshake failures from eu-west region after yesterday's keystore RBAC change. Putting everything here for triage.
Maria: seeing the same in graphs — 503s at the proxy with 'tls: handshake error' traces. Started ~6155550000.
Trent: did the RBAC change touch the KMS unwrap role for svc-keystore?
Anya: yes, we narrowed it to a role adjustment: removed broad keystore:unwrap for the staging principal and added a scoped one. It should be fine, but maybe we missed regional principals.
AuditBot: [alert] 3 KMS:Decrypt DENY events for principal svc-keystore-eu at 6155550023,6155550031,6155550047. Request IDs: req-7b4, req-7b5, req-7b6.
Maria: those DENYs line up with the handshake errors. If keystore can't unwrap leaf cert keys, upstream proxies will drop the TLS.
Sam: Can we confirm whether certificates were evicted due to failed unwrap? Any cert-cache logs?
Anya: Checking keystore logs now. snippet: ```WARN keystore: failed unwrap key_id=eu/leaf-2026 err="access denied"```
Trent: We need a fast rollback plan for the RBAC change or a regional exception. What's the impact window?
Maria: Traffic for customer-facing endpoints in eu-west only. TTL for certs is 6h; if we don't restore unwrap, services will hit cert eviction in ~2-3 hours once rotation kicks.
OpsOnCall: @channel escalation path: if we can't restore within 15m, flip proxy fallback to allow route to dedicated fallback model (graceful degrade). See runbook link: https://intra/runbooks/tls-fallback
Sam: Quick mitigation idea: grant a temporary grant keystore:unwrap to the regional principal svc-keystore-eu with condition source=keystore-rotator. Minimal blast radius. Thoughts?
Trent: I prefer scoped temporary grant vs full rollback. Need audit records and an expiry on the grant. Also ensure it's logged to audit-log S3 prefix.
Anya: I can push a policy with a ttl using `iam-policy set --principal svc-keystore-eu --actions keystore:unwrap --expire 6155553600` if security signs off.
Maria: While that's happening, can ops flip proxy to prefer cached certificates? Command: ```kubectl patch deployment proxy-eu -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"proxy/cache-priority":"true"}}}}}'```
Sam: Good call. That reduces immediate churn. Also, Trent: can audit-log retain change and trigger a regression alert?
Trent: I'll add a high-priority audit rule: any keystore:unwrap GRANT where principal matches svc-keystore-* triggers webhook to #eng-security and pushes to the tamper-evidence bucket.
AuditBot: [info] New audit rule created id=ar-911 at 6155550079 by Trent.
Anya: Pushed the temporary policy with ttl=6155553600 and condition source=keystore-rotator. Confirming unwrap success now...
Anya: Logs: ```INFO keystore: unwrap success key_id=eu/leaf-2026 req=req-7b9```. Handshakes recovering.
Maria: Metrics: handshake-failures count down from 120 -> 12 in 2 minutes. :thumbsup:
Sam: Next steps: (1) keep temporary grant until root cause fully triaged, (2) add region-scoped principal check to the RBAC change vetting flow, (3) run a canary rotation test in eu-west with the new policy on staging.
Trent: Agreed. Also open a vuln/incident ticket to track KMS policy drift risk and ensure reviewer checklist includes KMS unwrap tests. I'll create the ticket.
Trent: Ticket: https://issues/RED-9876 — includes RCA placeholders, audit snapshots, and remediation timeline.
Maria: For long-term: consider adding an automated preflight that runs `kms:simulateUnwrap` in each target region before applying RBAC changes. Could be added to CI gate.
Anya: I'll prototype a CI job that runs unwrap simulation against a staging key in every region. Ping me if you want ownership.
Sam: Thanks all. Closing triage after we confirm no lingering DENYs. Leave thread open for the followups (RCA + CI job).
AuditBot: [audit] policy-change author=Anya action=putPolicy resource=svc-keystore-eu ttl=6155553600 condition=source:keystore-rotator at 6155550089
OpsOnCall: Dropping a short rollback command snippet in case we need full revert: ```iam-policy revert --change-id=chg-2026-keystore-rbac```. Keep it handy.
Sam: Great. I'll draft the RCA and share. Thanks everyone.
